name: austin_recent
description: Recent records from a common Austin, TX open dataset (data.austintexas.gov) by friendly name — no Socrata id needed. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "recent crime in Austin", "Austin 311 requests", "Austin construction permits", "Austin restaurant inspection scores". Names: crime, 311, permits, restaurant_inspections. Returns the latest rows (newest-first). Add a SoQL `where` to filter; for anything else use austin_query.

where.description: Optional SoQL filter, e.g. "council_district=9". Omit for all recent rows.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: austin_query
description: Run a raw SoQL query against any Austin open-data resource (data.austintexas.gov) by its Socrata id (8-char like "fdj4-gpfu"). Full SoQL: where/select/group/order/limit/offset. Use austin_datasets to find a resource id, or austin_recent for the common ones.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: austin_datasets
description: Search the Austin open-data catalogue (data.austintexas.gov) for datasets by keyword. Returns dataset names, descriptions, and Socrata resource ids to use with austin_query.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.
